issues.description: Captures any issues that occurred while deserializing from filesystem

acceptedEmailValidationVerdicts.description:
{@link SendGrid#isValidEmail} makes an internal API request to
{@link SendGridEmailAddressValidationApi#validateEmailAddress}. If the validation verdict is part of these accepted
validation verdicts, {@link SendGrid#isValidEmail} returns true. If {@link acceptedEmailValidationScore} is
defined, that value overrides the list of accepted verdicts.

acceptedEmailValidationScore.description:
{@link SendGrid#isValidEmail} makes an internal API request to
{@link SendGridEmailAddressValidationApi#validateEmailAddress}. If the validation score is greater than or equal to
this value, {@link SendGrid#isValidEmail} returns true. If this value is undefined or null, the list of
{@link acceptedEmailValidationVerdicts} is used.
